queries:
WITH patient_stats AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB / HCT) AS ratio,
           AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_stats
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM patient_stats p, overall o
WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio;
WITH p AS (
  SELECT ID, AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
a AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM p, a
WHERE p.ratio > a.avg_ratio;
WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID,
           SUM(HGB) * 1.0 / SUM(HCT) AS ratio,
           AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING SUM(HCT) <> 0
),
a AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM p
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM p, a
WHERE p.ratio > a.avg_ratio;
WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS ratio, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0
    GROUP BY ID
),
g AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB * 1.0 / HCT) AS gavg
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE HGB IS NOT NULL AND HCT IS NOT NULL AND HCT != 0
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - g.gavg) AS mean_excess
FROM p, g
WHERE p.ratio > g.gavg;
